summary.short_summary: The meeting highlighted the strategic focus of QueryClick, led by Christopher Liversidge, on prioritizing its Corvadae AI software while considering the sale of its services business to ensure proper attention to both entities. QueryClick operates a 12-person remote team specializing in SEO and paid media marketing, with strong client relationships and stable revenue through long-term contracts. Index, represented by Andre Rizzo, shared its evolution from a service company to a product-focused AI business, aiming to double revenue this year. Both companies emphasize performance-driven sales and client retention, with Index interested in acquiring QueryClick to strengthen its presence in Europe and North America. The discussion concluded with plans for due diligence and further negotiations, highlighting the importance of a smooth transition for QueryClick’s brand and client trust.
